description: Read eleven lines from the margin, and gave Burbage no twin column.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Is not in the room. Her eight shillings stay under the candlestick, unpaid.
name: Edith Kettlewood

description: Named the share, kept the unpaid papers out of the division, and asked half in jest for a play that does not exist.
name: John Heminges

description: Stood over her box and was right to the penny.
name: Goodwife Margery Pell

description: Is at the rail in the king's mantle, and is only seen.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Asked the interest on Burbage, owned the eleven, and added nothing this afternoon.
name: Will Kemp

description: Said thirty shillings, refused the jest, and added nothing clever.
name: William Shakespeare
